events.title: Late Summerween: Development Update
events.summary: Welcome, dearest reader,The tea has grown cold in the several months since I dispatched my last missive. I recognize my silence has grown quite worrisome, as it should. After all, Goreytown is a place known for its unpleasantries and trickeries and the dismal fates many of our citizens befall.To those who have tapped the proverbial window and inquired after our questionable continued existence, let me put your minds at ease. We do unquestionably continue to exist. The fine folks at Sundew Studio

events.title: Midwinter Spirits: Development Update
events.summary: Welcome, proprietors...We're delighted to be part of this year's Midwinter Festival. What better way to celebrate than to sit by the fire and learn what we've been working on this past month since we announced Tearoom of Terror?First, here's where you'll be staying. This was once your aunt's bedroom, but now that she's dead, it's yours. When the fire is lit, it can be quite cozy...You also have a sundew that will help keep the kitchen free of pests.
